method: FFmpeg/libsndfile decode of a sample-aligned 44.1 kHz WAV export; fine 0.005 BPM zoom-DFT of onset strength at the fundamental, 2nd and 4th harmonics; phase from 120 strong broadband transients with onset backtracking and section-boundary/downbeat cross-check. The runtime MP3 is 51.156 ms later than the WAV at the start, middle and end, so authored times are converted to its clock.
